annotations.title: Upload a video to Microsoft Advertising

description: Upload videos (a Hermoso render, or the user’s own clip: any direct-download https file or an upload_file URL) to Microsoft Advertising, or check ones already uploaded with videoIds: Draft (still processing), Active, or Failed with Microsoft’s reason. Microsoft enables video per account and refuses clips under 6 seconds. Use the ids in create_microsoft_ads_image_ad(videoIds). Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

description.description: description stored with the uploaded video

urls.description: direct-download https URLs of videos to upload; clips under 6 seconds are refused

videoIds.description: existing video ids to check the status of, instead of uploading

name: upload_microsoft_ads_video
